text:
maria: CI red on hosted-integ (shard 5). Tests failing: AuthHandshakeError, stream chunk mismatch, toolcall 502. attaching top logs.

ajit: thanks — pinging ci-bot to rerun shard 5

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild: hosted-integ/shard-5 (#2049123456-rerun) queued

lucy: Any recent infra changes? I saw proxy updates two days ago.

maria: yeah proxy timeouts rolled in yesterday (PR #412). I can bisect if rerun is red again.

ajit: Can someone paste the minimal failing trace? Root looks like auth header missing in replay

maria: ```
2024-11-03T08:12:04Z ERROR AuthHandshakeError: missing auth token
  at auth_proxy.go:87
2024-11-03T08:12:04Z WARN stream: unexpected EOF while reading chunk
2024-11-03T08:12:04Z ERROR toolcall: downstream 502 from tool-runner
```

lucy: looks like 401 on preflight then stream shutdown — maybe header strip at proxy

ajit: If rerun shows same, let's bisect between infra deploys 2024-11-01..2024-11-03

maria: rerun finished.

ci-bot: Rerun result: hosted-integ/shard-5 — FAILED
Summary: integration/hosted_auth_stream_test.py::test_toolcall_streaming_auth — 1 failed, 12 passed

oncall-bot: assigning @ajit, @maria to triage

ajit: I'll grab the bisect. Maria can you save the failing request payload + headers and share curl repro?

maria: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://hosted-api.redwood.test/v1/stream?session=abc" \
  -d '{"input":"hello","tools":[{"name":"fetch","args":{}}]}'
# response: 401 Unauthorized then stream closed
```

lucy: could be nginx keepalive/upgrade. @infra please confirm if we rolled nginx on 11/02

infra: we rolled nginx 1.22 -> 1.24 on 2024-11-02 on canary, then staged. no explicit keepalive changes but TLS stack bumped.

ajit: good lead. Plan: bisect nginx version on canary, run smoke for auth+toolcall streaming. If reproduces, we can revert or adjust header passthrough.

maria: :thumbsup: starting bisect now, will post progress and failing trace. if anyone has quick ideas tag me.

ajit: also add short-lived tracing flag to proxy to capture header flow: `PROXY_TRACE=1`

maria: done, enabling trace for the next rerun.

lucy: thanks — looping in product if this risks customer-facing outages.

product-bot: Notified product on incident channel

maria: updating thread as bisect proceeds.
